strict_scale_note: SCENARIO_TOO_SMALL for large_system_strict without padding. Natural bind incident is ~1600 reachable solver-visible LOC with 50 interacting TF/K8s resources; cloning env/dr or unused helm values would only inflate the gate.

root_cause_clusters.RC1_TOKEN_INTERP: Sonar analysis token never reaches the Jenkins credentials store under the contracted id and secret key.
root_cause_clusters.RC2_INGRESS_GROUP: Shared platform-ingress listener disagrees on group name or per-host healthcheck paths, so sibling hostnames flap.
root_cause_clusters.RC3_EXTDNS_SYNC: ExternalDNS sync ownership or hostname annotations do not match Ingress hosts, so sync deletes or never publishes names.
root_cause_clusters.RC4_JDBC_IDENTITY: Sonar JDBC uses the wrong postgres identity (endpoint:port doubled, embedded PG, or Jenkins pointed at RDS).
root_cause_clusters.RC5_EFS_HOME: Jenkins home is not isolated on the access-point uid/path contract, or Artifactory shares the same directory.
root_cause_clusters.RC6_SCHEDULE: Controller placement or executor count lets scans write the EFS home or miss the control taint.
root_cause_clusters.RC7_SSM_RUNNER: Ansible dispatch falls back to SSH or the on-prem inventory instead of the SSM document contract.
root_cause_clusters.RC8_BIND_ORDER: Reload applies the token before Sonar is UP or recreates Jenkins home, so the bind is not idempotent.

defects.observable_failure: jenkins-sonarqube-token secret key is token instead of sonarqube-token, so JCasC mount is empty.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Hardcoding the minted token into JCasC plaintext still breaks the next TFC rotation.

defects.observable_failure: Helm additionalExistingSecrets keyName does not match the K8s secret data key.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Renaming the JCasC credential id without fixing the mount leaves withSonarQubeEnv empty.

defects.observable_failure: JCasC string credential id is sonar-token rather than sonarqube-token.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Updating only sonarGlobalConfiguration.credentialsId leaves the store id mismatched.

defects.observable_failure: Sonar installation serverUrl uses the RDS hostname instead of https://sonar.platform.test.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Scans that bypass ingress look green until ExternalDNS or TLS is required.

defects.observable_failure: Sonar installation name is not SonarQube, so withSonarQubeEnv misses the bind.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Calling the scanner with a raw host URL hides the missing named installation.

defects.observable_failure: Sonar Ingress healthcheck path is /login, so the shared target group marks sonar unhealthy.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Splitting sonar onto its own group.name restores that host and breaks the shared listener contract.

defects.observable_failure: Artifactory Ingress healthcheck path is / instead of /artifactory/api/system/ping.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Disabling the artifactory host to stop flaps drops a contracted public name.

defects.observable_failure: Jenkins Ingress alb group.name drifted to jenkins-ingress, splitting the listener.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Giving every host its own group makes isolated curls pass and fails the one-listener rule.

defects.observable_failure: Jenkins healthcheck path is / instead of /login.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Forcing the proxy to ignore healthchecks hides placement and JDBC faults.

defects.observable_failure: Sonar Ingress hostname annotation is sonar.platform.internal, not sonar.platform.test.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Adding a static zone file row without fixing the annotation is deleted on the next sync.

defects.observable_failure: txtOwnerId is platform-mvp instead of platform-mvp-dev, so sync steals sibling names.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Switching policy to upsert-only hides deletes instead of restoring ownership.

defects.observable_failure: domainFilters omit platform.test, so no public names are published.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Writing /etc/hosts on the controller fakes resolution without TXT ownership.

defects.observable_failure: JDBC URL concatenates aws_db_instance.endpoint (host:port) with an extra :5432.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Stripping the port in the scanner still leaves Sonar itself DOWN.

defects.observable_failure: postgresql.enabled is true, so Sonar ignores the RDS identity.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Pointing Jenkins at embedded postgres looks UP and diverges from the ternary.

defects.observable_failure: jdbcOverwrite password secret key is db-password instead of password.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Baking the password into values.yaml survives one apply and fails rotation.

defects.observable_failure: rds_endpoint_override is ignored when non-empty, so restore/override priority is wrong.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Always selecting the restored hostname breaks the default primary identity.

defects.observable_failure: Jenkins home directory is owned by uid 0 instead of the access-point uid 1000.
defects.partial_fix_trap: chmod 777 on the shared FS lets Artifactory write Jenkins job history.

defects.observable_failure: Artifactory PVC mountPath equals the Jenkins home path.
defects.partial_fix_trap: One RWX volume for both products passes capacity checks and corrupts home on reload.

defects.observable_failure: StorageClass reclaim policy is Delete, so a helm roll wipes Jenkins home.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Snapshotting once then leaving Delete still destroys the next bounce.

defects.observable_failure: Jenkins controller numExecutors is 2, so quality-gate work writes the EFS home.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Pinning agents to control nodes without zeroing executors still dirties home.

defects.observable_failure: Jenkins controller nodeSelector is role=platform-exec, missing the control taint toleration.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Removing the taint from control nodes lets agents crowd the EFS writer.

defects.observable_failure: AWS ansible inventory uses ansible_connection=ssh instead of aws_ssm.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Adding port 22 to the runner security group makes playbooks run and fails the SSM-only rule.

defects.observable_failure: ANSIBLE_RUNNER_ID is unset in Jenkins global env, so SSM send-command has no instance.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Hardcoding an instance id in the playbook breaks the next runner replacement.

defects.observable_failure: AWS inventory points at the on-prem hosts file with an SSH private key path.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Copying the on-prem key into the image restores deploy and reopens SSH.

defects.observable_failure: Reload writes the Sonar token while /api/system/status is not UP, then keeps the failed bind.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Retrying reload without fixing JDBC still stores an unauthorized credential.

defects.observable_failure: Second reload mints a replacement analysis token instead of reusing the TFC var.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Deleting jenkins-home to force a clean JCasC load also drops Job DSL state.
